# Safe git command log (Group C 후속 후속 PoC L3 PASS fixture)
# 답습: 사양 §7 — dangerous pattern catalog 외 정상 명령
git status
git fetch origin
git pull --ff-only origin main
git checkout -b feature/example
git add tools/example.py
git commit -m "feat(example): add example tool"
git push origin feature/example
git log --oneline -5
git diff main..feature/example
